answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the vine log reveals the live set and the violet audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 449 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Keeping 164 aliases alive therefore means 164 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the velvet quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
